lie awake all night: Worried about the big exam the next morning, Tom would lie awake all night staring at the ceiling.
因為擔心隔天早上的大考，湯姆整夜躺著睡不著，一直盯著天花板。
wide awake: After drinking two cups of coffee at ten p.m., I was still wide awake at midnight and couldn't fall asleep.
晚上十點喝了兩杯咖啡後，我到半夜仍完全清醒，怎麼也睡不著。
be awake to the danger: Villagers living near the river must be awake to the danger of floods during the typhoon season.
住在河邊的村民在颱風季節必須意識到洪水的危險。
keep someone awake: Loud music from the party next door can keep someone awake for hours, so I asked them to turn it down.
隔壁派對的吵雜音樂會讓人好幾個小時睡不著，所以我請他們把音量調小。
be aware of the risks: Before signing up for the mountain trip, all students should be aware of the risks and read the safety guide.
報名登山活動前，所有學生都應該意識到風險，並閱讀安全指南。
environmentally aware: My sister is very environmentally aware; she always brings her own bag and bottle and recycles everything.
我姊姊非常有環保意識；她總是自備購物袋和水瓶，而且什麼都回收。
become aware that…: Halfway to school, I began to become aware that I had left my homework on the kitchen table.
走到半路，我開始察覺到我把作業忘在廚房桌上了。
as far as I am aware: As far as I am aware, the meeting is still at three o'clock, but you can check with the manager.
就我所知，會議仍然是三點，不過你可以向經理確認。
an awful lot of money: Fixing the old car cost us an awful lot of money, so we decided to buy a new one instead.
修那輛舊車花了我們一大筆錢，所以我們決定改買新車。
feel awful about it: I broke my friend's favorite cup by accident, and I still feel awful about it even though she forgave me.
我不小心打破了朋友最愛的杯子，雖然她原諒我了，我還是對此感到很糟。
an awful mistake: Sending the private message to the whole class group was an awful mistake that Amy deeply regretted.
把私訊傳到全班群組是一個嚴重的錯誤，艾咪對此深感後悔。
look awful: You look awful this morning; did you stay up late again? Maybe you should see the school nurse.
你今天早上氣色很差；你又熬夜了嗎？也許你該去看一下學校護理師。
an awkward silence: When nobody laughed at his joke, there was an awkward silence, and everyone looked down at their phones.
沒有人對他的笑話發笑時，現場一陣尷尬的沉默，大家都低頭看手機。
an awkward question: A reporter asked the mayor an awkward question about the missing money, and he refused to answer it.
一位記者問了市長一個關於失蹤款項的難以回答的問題，他拒絕回答。
at an awkward moment: My phone rang at an awkward moment, right in the middle of the principal's speech in the school hall.
我的手機在不恰當的時刻響了，正好在校長於禮堂演講的時候。
an awkward position: When my two best friends had a fight, I was put in an awkward position because I didn't want to take sides.
當我兩個最好的朋友吵架時，我陷入進退兩難的處境，因為我不想選邊站。
awkward to use: The new remote control has so many small buttons that it is awkward to use, especially for my grandparents.
新的遙控器有好多小按鈕，很不好用，尤其對我的祖父母來說。
go bankrupt: After losing customers for three years, the small bookstore finally ran out of money and had to go bankrupt.
連續三年流失顧客後，那家小書店終於把錢用光，不得不破產。
be declared bankrupt: Unable to pay back his huge debts to the banks, the businessman was declared bankrupt by the court last year.
那位商人無法償還欠銀行的巨額債務，去年被法院宣告破產。
morally bankrupt: Many people felt that a company selling unsafe food to children just to save money was morally bankrupt.
許多人覺得一家為了省錢而把不安全食品賣給孩童的公司是道德淪喪的。
a bankrupt policy: Critics called the plan a bankrupt policy because it had failed to create jobs after ten years.
批評者稱這項計畫是徹底失敗的政策，因為實施十年後仍沒創造出工作機會。
the bare minimum: Kevin always does the bare minimum in group projects, so the rest of us end up doing most of the work.
凱文在小組作業中總是只做最起碼的部分，所以最後大部分工作都落到我們身上。
the bare facts: The news report gave only the bare facts of the accident, without any opinions or emotional details.
這則新聞報導只提供了事故赤裸裸的事實，沒有任何意見或煽情的細節。
the bare essentials: For the camping trip, we packed only the bare essentials: a tent, water, some food, and a flashlight.
這趟露營我們只帶了最基本的必需品：一頂帳篷、水、一些食物和一支手電筒。
with one's bare hands: Without any tools, the firefighter lifted the heavy stones with his bare hands to save the trapped child.
在沒有任何工具的情況下，消防員赤手空拳地搬開沉重的石頭，救出受困的孩子。
a bare room: After the movers took away all the furniture, our old apartment was just a bare room with nothing on the walls.
搬家工人搬走所有家具後，我們的舊公寓只剩一間空蕩的房間，牆上什麼都沒有。
barren land: Without enough rain for years, the farm turned into barren land where no crops could grow.
多年雨量不足，那座農場變成了一片種不出任何作物的荒地。
a barren discussion: After three hours of a barren discussion, the committee still had not reached any decision about the budget.
經過三個小時毫無結果的討論，委員會對預算仍未做出任何決定。
a barren period: The writer went through a barren period of five years when he could not finish a single new story.
那位作家經歷了長達五年毫無成果的時期，一篇新故事都寫不完。
